fields.inlineHelpText: Pending/Initiated = active, generates payments. Completed = finished (a Once order becomes Completed when the payment is CREATED, not when it is accepted). Stopped = on hold: a late fee order is born Stopped when an ACH payment is rejected, is activated by hand, and is cancelled automatically if the bank collects the original payment. Canceled = contract cancelled or late fee no longer owed. More: Knowledge article 'Monee: facturación y cobros (Chargebee y ACH)'.

fields.inlineHelpText: What the order collects: AC (one order, or two if the AC is in installments), Subscription (monthly fee, created when the contract is activated), Fee, or Late payment fee (created automatically when a payment is rejected: original amount + penalty).

picklistValues.label: Customer pays amount owed and makes more than one payment
picklistValues.value: Customer pays amount owed and makes more than one payment

fields.calculatedFormula:
IF( 
	AND(
             TEXT(SM_Payment_Type__c)='Late payment fee',
             TEXT(SM_Payment_Status__c) = 'Stopped',
             SM_Bank__c = "BANCO POPULAR"
         ),        			 
	30 - CEILING((TODAY() -  SM_Date_ACH_Transmitted__c)), 
	IF(
		AND(
			 TEXT(SM_Payment_Type__c)='Late payment fee',
			 TEXT(SM_Payment_Status__c) = 'Stopped',
			 SM_Bank__c <> "BANCO POPULAR"
			),            
			  10 - CEILING((TODAY() -  SM_Date_ACH_Transmitted__c)),
			null
			) 
)

fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(
   AND(
      Discount_Original_Subtotal__c>0,
      OR(SM_Discount_Percentage__c>0,SM_Discount_Value__c >0),
      ISPICKVAL(SM_Discount_Type__c , "Percentage")),
   Discount_Original_Subtotal__c-(Discount_Original_Subtotal__c* SM_Discount_Percentage__c), 
   Discount_Original_Subtotal__c- SM_Discount_Value__c )
